paper_title: A quantum-enhanced search for dark matter axions
notes: Quantum-enhanced axion haloscope search using squeezed state receiver (SSR). Exclusion limit: g_γ ≥ 1.38 × g_γ^KSVZ over combined mass windows 16.96–17.12 µeV/c² and 17.14–17.28 µeV/c². The KSVZ coupling constant g_γ^KSVZ ≈ 3.92 × 10^-16 GeV^-1 (derived from standard QCD axion models). Reported as 90% confidence level exclusion via Bayesian power-measured analysis. Data acquisition Sept 2019–Apr 2020. Achieved 4.0 dB off-resonant squeezing, yielding ~1.9× scan rate enhancement over quantum limit. DM density 0.45 GeV/cm³ is the standard local galactic halo density assumption for haloscope experiments.
